That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies across multiple blockchain networks. For practical digital product sales, the most operationally useful options are USDT on Tron — fastest settlement under 60 seconds, fees under $0.10, widely held in restricted markets — USDT on Ethereum — higher fees but the most widely supported chain globally — Bitcoin — highest global recognition, 10 to 60 minute confirmation depending on network congestion — Solana — fast settlement, fees of fractions of a cent, growing adoption — and BNB on Binance Smart Chain — popular in Southeast Asia and widely available through Binance.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your NOWPayments digital store, gather essential tools: a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, a NOWPayments account for processing transactions, and a method for product storage such as Google Drive or Supabase. Ensure you have digital products ready for sale, such as ebooks, courses, or software. Establishing your digital presence with these tools sets the groundwork for a robust ecommerce setup.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by integrating NOWPayments into your chosen hosting platform. Use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle backend logic, ensuring automatic payment verification. Configure webhooks to enable instant product delivery upon payment confirmation. This setup guarantees a smooth transaction process that operates efficiently on networks like Solana and Tron, where transaction fees are minimal.
Immediate crypto payments empower creators with instant access to their income.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your digital store is configured, it's time to go live. Publish your store and promote it across your networks to attract customers. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments system will handle the transaction, verifying payment on-chain in real-time. Monitor your dashboard to ensure everything functions correctly and address any potential issues promptly to maintain a seamless buying experience.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The transaction log in a COREMERCH deployment provides a complete, independently verifiable audit trail of every payment. Each entry includes the transaction hash, which links directly to the public blockchain record. You can verify any transaction independently on Tronscan, Etherscan, Solscan, or the relevant blockchain explorer — no platform intermediary required. If a buyer claims they paid but the transaction does not appear in your order log, you check the blockchain directly. This level of cryptographic verifiability is structurally impossible with conventional payment processors.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for your digital products, set up a NOWPayments account and integrate it with your website. This allows you to accept various cryptocurrencies without significant fees or restrictions. Compared to PayPal, USDT payments can arrive much faster, typically within minutes, especially on low-fee networks like Tron and Solana.
NOWPayments eliminates geographical restrictions, allowing global commerce.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The complete payment pipeline — from buyer checkout to local currency in your account — involves three components: NOWPayments for on-chain verification, your sovereign stack backend for order processing and delivery, and a P2P exchange for conversion to local currency. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the first two components under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete process including P2P conversion guidance for Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. Both available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Configure your payout destination before configuring your store. Your self-custody wallet address goes into NOWPayments as the destination for each coin you accept — this is where funds land when a transaction confirms on-chain. Never use an exchange wallet address as your NOWPayments destination — use a self-custody wallet where you control the private keys. Set up Binance P2P or a local exchange and verify the conversion process for your local currency pair. Deploy your stack and run a mainnet test. After the first real sale confirms, wait for the transaction to fully clear in NOWPayments, then transfer from your self-custody wallet to your exchange for conversion.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?
Set up a NOWPayments account, integrate it with your digital store, and ensure you have a reliable method for product delivery. Customers can then pay using various cryptocurrencies.
How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal?
USDT payments processed on networks like Tron can arrive in minutes, while PayPal transactions may take longer due to banking processes and restrictions.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to naira?
Creators can use peer-to-peer platforms like Binance or Patricia to convert Bitcoin to naira. These services facilitate safe conversions without relying on traditional banking systems.
What are the fees associated with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% for transactions, making it an economical choice compared to traditional payment platforms that often have higher fees.
Can I use NOWPayments for recurring payments?
Currently, NOWPayments does not support recurring payments directly. However, you can handle recurring transactions through custom scripts or additional backend logic.
Transaction fees on Tron are under $0.10, ensuring economical operations.
